root.name: Queen's Gambit Accepted: Janowski-Larsen Variation
root.moves: 1. d4 d5 2. c4 dxc4 3. Nf3 Nf6 4. e3 Bg4

overview: Black develops the bishop to g4 before ...e6, pinning the Nf3, then recaptures on c4 after 5.Bxc4 e6. White develops with Nc3, O-O, h3 or Qb3, and Black plays ...Nbd7, ...Bxf3 or ...c5 and ...Be7. The game is open and active, with a slight space edge for White and an easy development for Black. It is a respectable QGA line.

white_ideas.idea: Take c4 with the bishop and develop Nc3, O-O and h3
Play e4 and build a centre

black_ideas.idea: Pin the knight and trade it with ...Bxf3

typical_structures.structure: QGA open centre with White d4/e3 against Black e6/d-file semi-open

character.notes: Even and active; neither safe nor sharp.

structure.notes: QGA structure with the c-pawn gone and central exchanges, open.

approach.notes: A standard QGA line, regularly played.

level.notes: Plans are straightforward but sensitive to move order.
